title: Reviewing your own pull request before anyone else does

videos.script: In a team, nobody merges code that nobody else has read. In a portfolio project there is nobody else, so the first reviewer of every change is you, and the second is the stranger deciding whether to hire you. {{second}} Reviewing your own change sounds pointless, since you wrote it. It is not, because reading a diff is a different activity from writing code. When you write, you see what you meant. When you read the diff, you see what you did. {{meant}} Here, one of loanbook's changes gets that reading. A search finds two slips in it. Only reading finds the third problem.
